sequential_five_component_accounting.accounting: five directly composed clean component modules executed sequentially with one shared pressure/composition input, all component loading/gas/face inputs and next-gas outputs retained, and arithmetic workspace reused

register_interface_finding: recompiling the standalone LDF microsteps at the loading-sign widths removes the current/next loading-register mismatch and permits direct clean circuit composition; it also exposes the cost of preserving the smaller loading difference
accuracy_boundary: the widened LDF precision screen and the loading-sign/cell-balance precision screen are both passed on the frozen physical cache, but the LDF arithmetic remains constant-specialized rather than driven by reversible run-specific capacity, affinity, and kinetic parameter registers

claim_boundary.supported: all-to-all u/CX compilation of clean, register-compatible one-cell one-second LDF-to-loading-sign-to-solid-conversion-to-interior-cell-balance modules for all five components
claim_boundary.unsupported: direct oriented-face generation and composition normalization, reversible run-specific LDF parameters, boundary-cell valve/tank withdrawal, adaptive phase integration, a complete phase/cycle, routing, hardware feasibility, or quantum advantage
